title: Sign-out and sessions
subtitle: RP-initiated logout, SSO lifetime and what each app keeps
summary: Signing out of any module calls Keycloak's end-session endpoint (OIDC RP-initiated logout), which ends the SSO session for all modules and TurfBot. Each Spring app keeps an HTTP session with the authenticated user; TurfBot keeps a signed cookie; APIs keep nothing.

sections.title: Logout handler
What lives where
rows: Signed Flask cookie TC_CHATBOT_SID (user, roles, id_token)

sections.title: Notes
items: Post-logout redirect goes to /logged-out on the module, allowed by the client's post-logout redirect URIs ("+" = same as redirect URIs).
Roles are read at sign-in: after a role change in Keycloak, the user signs out and in again.
